reason: There is an obstacle: your radiators would need about >70 °C on the coldest days, above the 60 °C a heat pump handles well; bigger radiators or less heat loss would fix it.
path_to_yellow: Add about 19.5 kW radiator output for 55 °C (11.2 kW for 60 °C); today 18.0 kW.
Or cut the heat loss by about 52% (insulation or windows) to reach 55 °C with today's radiators.
Single-pipe loop: larger radiators at the end of the loop, a higher flow temperature, or converting parts of the system (installer to check bypasses and balancing).
cost_note: At least this much: the real running cost is higher above 60 °C.
